say: Karatun canjin yanayi a cikin gidan ku da al'ummar ku.

panel.heading: Kalmomi guda uku don dukan karatun

cards.d: Canza yadda muke rayuwa da aiki don rage cutarwa, kamar adana ruwa kafin lokacin rani.
Rage iskar gas da muke ƙarawa, kamar amfani da ƙarancin gawayi ko shuka da kare bishiyoyi.
Shayar da girgiza kamar ambaliya, murmurewa da sauri, da dawowa da ƙarfi, ba mafi talauci ba.
